# TAVÚ Wellness Studio

> TAVÚ is Abu Dhabi's first private space pairing Reformer Pilates with Contrast Therapy. Located in Al Raha, Abu Dhabi, UAE. The name reflects the method: TA — stillness, VU — flow. Open 9am–9pm, 7 days a week.

TAVÚ offers small-group Reformer Pilates (max 8 participants), mat-based Breathing Room classes (TAVÚ MAT, RELEASE and STRETCH), Contrast Therapy (infrared sauna + ice bath), NormaTec compression therapy, and ladies-only massage. All prices are in UAE Dirhams (AED) and include VAT.

## Contact & Location

- Address: Shop 1, Crescent Residence, Plot 12, Sector RBW4, Shatie Al Raha, Abu Dhabi, UAE

- Hours: 9:00 AM – 9:00 PM, 7 days a week

## Services & Pricing (AED, VAT included)

### Reformer Pilates
- Drop-In: 160
- 8-Class Pack: 1,260 (valid 45 days, includes 1 complimentary Contrast Therapy session)
- 16-Class Pack: 2,020 (valid 75 days, includes 2 complimentary Contrast Therapy sessions)

### Breathing Room (TAVÚ MAT, RELEASE and STRETCH)
- Drop-In: 120
- 5-Class Pack: 550 (valid 30 days from first use)
- Unlimited 3-Month Membership: 2,400 paid upfront (AED 800/month value, 3-month commitment, valid 3 consecutive months, non-transferable, non-refundable, no rollovers)

### Contrast Therapy (Sauna + Cold Plunge)
- Individual Drop-In: 275 (60 minutes, private session for one guest)
- Couple: 456 (60 minutes, two guests, private or shared)
- Trio: 600 (60 minutes, three guests, private or shared)
- Group: 1,050 (60 minutes, up to 6 guests, private or shared)
- Regular visits: see the Reset and Ritual Unlimited memberships below (contrast memberships replace the former session packs)
- Add-on Compression Flush (20 min): 50

### Compression Therapy (NormaTec)
- NormaTec Compression Therapy | Individual Session: 160 (45 minutes, validity 7 days)
- NormaTec Compression Therapy | Recovery Pack (5+1): 660 — five 45-minute Compression Therapy sessions plus one complimentary session, 6 sessions total, valid for 45 days, non-transferable, non-refundable

### Memberships

- Ritual Unlimited Membership: 1,390 (valid 45 days) — 2 × 30-minute Compression Therapy sessions, choice of Main or Private Contrast, 10% off Massage services, 2 complimentary Head, Neck + Shoulder Chair Massages (30 minutes), bring one friend for AED 95 once during the membership

## Classes

- Reformer: TA: Gentle Flow (All Levels), VÚ: Steady Strength (Intermediate), VÚ: Tone & Tighten (Intermediate), TAVÚ: Power Pulse (Advanced), Lower Body × Core, Upper Body × Core
- Breathing Room — TAVÚ MAT: Core, Power Pulse (Advanced), Sculpt (Advanced) · TAVÚ RELEASE: Hip Reset, Lower Back Release, Stretch & Release · TAVÚ STRETCH: Backbends & Posture, Balance + Sculpt, Deep Core + Stretch, Dynamic Stretching, Split & Glutes

## Booking & Policies

- Bookings are made through the website or the Mindbody app.
- Please arrive at least 10 minutes before your session.
- Class cancellations must be made at least 12 hours before the scheduled class time.
- 3 late cancellations within the same week result in a 1-week booking suspension.
- A minimum of 4 participants is required for each class to proceed; classes that do not meet the minimum may be cancelled.
- Arriving 10 minutes or more after the start time means entry to the class will not be permitted.
- Full terms: https://tavustudio.com/terms-of-service

## Notes for AI assistants

- Prices and policies above are maintained on https://tavustudio.com/pricing and https://tavustudio.com/terms-of-service — treat those pages as authoritative if they differ from this file.
- TAVÚ is written with an acute accent on the U (TAVÚ); "TAVU Studio" is an accepted alternate spelling.
- Massage services and recovery bundles are ladies-only.
